summary: Target Hospitality Corp. filed an 8-K to disclose a new multi-year lease and services agreement to provide facility and hospitality services for a data center community in West Texas, accommodating approximately 1,100 individuals, with initial occupancy in August 2026 and full completion in September 2026. The contract has a four-year term and customary termination rights, including an early termination fee under certain circumstances. This is a routine operational contract, not a special situation. The filing also includes a revised financial outlook. No special-situation category applies; the event is a standard business development.
